{{Quote|You call yourself a smuggler, Solo, and I'll grant you your reputation, but I'm operating on a whole other level here.|Perla to Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 5">[[Star Wars (2013) 5|''Star Wars'' (2013) 5]]</ref>}}
'''Perla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who worked for the [[Imperial Center Sanitation Department]]. Perla used her job to run a large-scale [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation, utilizing the department's [[Garbage barge/Legends|barges]]. Her successes were based on the lack of inspection on the barges. She offered [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] an opportunity to get off of Coruscant without notice if he paid her a large sum. it turns out that she had been delivering a stockpile of weapons and supplies to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in exchange to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. After giving the supplies, she was offered by Mothma to command a freighter in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]].
